aboutHtml:
We're Bill and Shelley, and STIHL SHOP Sydenham is our commitment to bringing quality outdoor power equipment to Christchurch. Our team knows this gear inside out—from maintenance and repair to helping you find the right tool for your job. We stock STIHL and a full range of other leading outdoor equipment brands. Our fully equipped Platinum Workshop is ready for servicing, repairs, and advice when you need it.

Whether you're after a new machine, spare parts, workshop service, or just honest guidance on what to use, we're here to help. We offer Click & Collect and Home Delivery to make things easier, and we're open seven days a week. Come in and see us—we'd like to help.
